knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Work outside training or authority is paused, escalated and documented. The lesson says never to mark unfinished work as complete.
The handover includes location and job reference, completed scope, exceptions, evidence, client instructions and a follow-up owner.
The workplace procedure says to identify outstanding items and why they remain incomplete before leaving.

practicalCriteria: Checks the site/task requirements before acting
Identifies and applies relevant safety and privacy controls
Communicates professionally and respects authorisation boundaries
Records the outcome and escalates unresolved issues correctly
passRule: All safety-critical criteria must be demonstrated; remediate and reassess any missed criterion.
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Review the job instructions, then compare the completed tasks against the work order before you leave.
Record of procedure step 3: Identify each outstanding item and record why it is incomplete. Never mark unfinished work as complete.
Record of procedure step 4: Report defects, damage, hazards, inaccessible areas and requests for variations through the approved channel.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 3 is not done: Identify each outstanding item and record why it is incomplete. Never mark unfinished work as complete.
Stop work if procedure step 4 is not done: Report defects, damage, hazards, inaccessible areas and requests for variations through the approved channel.
Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Separate a routine quality issue from an immediate safety threat. Stop unsafe work, move to a safe place and contact emergency services when necessary.
